edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 30,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 calendar days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.

2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, each party releases the other from all claims arising out of or relating to the matters described in the recitals, whether known or unknown, through the date of this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal or tax advisers, provided those advisers are informed of their confidential nature, or to the extent disclosure is required by law.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
